summary: I documented the wake scheduler spec into notes/port-question.md — the EXIT-trap mechanism writing run/<name>.wake_at, the delay-ladder defaults, and backoff state location — then acted on the share hint by sending the operator a pinned port contract covering the six CLIs + jq, env wire-ins, and the wake-clock mechanism with its one tiny external poller. I deliberately chose an outward share over a third archive-only note so the specs the operator asked about could actually be used.
